items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Each W3 acceptance criterion maps to code and a test (rows/dialog/actions, Done+Snooze routes, Start task pre-fill, error banners, hostile text, sidebar count, real-browser E2E).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unavailable tool, failed request, triageError and damaged lines each show a banner and suppress the inbox-is-clear card; failed Done/Snooze/Add show the tool message and keep the row or form.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: All reminder text is a React text node; only http(s) url links are anchors; the stored command is inert text and never read by Start task; the WebUI writes no reminder file.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Model, problems, count, page, dialog, layout count and two real-browser specs (mocked tool, real tool); hostile text proven in jsdom and Chromium.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One shared 120 s query for page and sidebar; no per-row polling; background refetch off.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files under 300 lines; baselined InboxPage.test.tsx kept at its 645-line baseline; inputs live outside the Inbox no-write-path tree.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Server due answer to client contract probed with the real reminder tool end to end (create, snooze, done, secret refusal) and with mocked unavailable/degraded states.
